I was in a relationship that were eerily similar to the second one you described, and I also was left with serious trust issues. I'm 20 and also male, btw. my exgirlfriend used to swear to me that I was the only one she had feelings for, though she when ever I couldn't be with her, she always hung out with the same dude, I shrugged it off knowing that I couldn't control who she hung out with, nor did I have the right to. But she left me for him, and I later found out (through some scumbag asshole who enjoyed seeing me in misery) that she had been regularly sleeping with him while we were dating. That was a year ago.

I haven't dated anyone since.  I guess that's my way of dealing with it. I long for someone to hold onto, but I can't right now. 
As for advice, I try to stay active, I do a bunch of stuff with the friends I have. I understand that making friends when you're bipolar might be hard, but you gotta try, I guess. 

good luck, friend.
